Gaudete Sunday Festive Fruit Punch

Served at: Gaudete Sunday

Serves 8-10Prep 15 min

Gaudete Sunday, the third Sunday of Advent, is a time of joyful anticipation, marked by rose vestments and a spirit of rejoicing. This festive fruit punch, with its vibrant colors and sweet-tart flavors, perfectly embodies the celebratory mood of the day, offering a refreshing treat for family and friends.

Ingredients

  • 4 cups (960 mL) cranberry juice, chilled
  • 2 cups (480 mL) orange juice, chilled
  • 1 cup (240 mL) pineapple juice, chilled
  • 1/2 cup (120 mL) fresh lime juice, chilled
  • 2 liters (about 8.5 cups) ginger ale or sparkling cider, chilled
  • 1 cup (150 g) fresh cranberries, for garnish
  • 1 orange, thinly sliced, for garnish
  • Optional: Ice ring or extra ice cubes

Method

  1. In a large punch bowl, combine the chilled cranberry juice, orange juice, pineapple juice, and fresh lime juice.
  2. Stir gently to combine all the juices.
  3. Just before serving, slowly pour in the chilled ginger ale or sparkling cider.
  4. Add the fresh cranberries and orange slices to the punch bowl for garnish.
  5. Serve immediately over ice, or with an ice ring to keep it cold without diluting.

Tips

  • For an extra festive touch, freeze some cranberries and orange slices in an ice ring or individual ice cubes.
  • Adjust the sweetness by adding a tablespoon or two of simple syrup if you prefer a sweeter punch.
  • You can prepare the juice mixture ahead of time and store it in the refrigerator, adding the sparkling beverage and garnishes just before serving.
